fundamentals.name: Datadog, Inc.
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: Datadog, Inc. operates an observability and security platform for cloud applications in the United States and internationally. The company's products comprise infrastructure and application performance monitoring, log management, observability pipelines, synthetics, real user monitoring, product analytics, continuous profiler, database monitoring, data observability, LLM observability, error tracking, network monitoring, incident response, workflow automation and App builder, event management, bits AI SRE, cloud cost management, cloud security, code security, cloud SIEM, threat management, sensitive data scanner, and CI visibility. Datadog, Inc. was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in New York, New York.

judgment.summary: Rapidly growing software company with high margins but a thin operating profit and a premium valuation.
judgment.earningsRecap: Last quarter beat EPS estimate by 18.3%; next earnings date is 2026-08-06.
positives: Revenue growth 32.2% YoY and quarterly earnings growth 113.4% indicate strong top-line and bottom-line expansion.
Gross margin of 79.9% is best-in-class, supporting high revenue growth.
Strong free cash flow of $936.73M TTM provides financial flexibility.
Consensus analyst rating is strong buy with a high mean target.
Current ratio of 3.40 and quick ratio of 3.29 indicate excellent short-term liquidity.
negatives: Trailing P/E of 589.41 and forward P/E of 80.77 represent a very high valuation.
Operating margin of 0.8% and profit margin of 3.7% are thin despite high gross margins.
Return on assets of -0.2% suggests inefficient asset utilization.
Debt/Equity ratio of 32.22, while not excessively high, indicates some reliance on debt financing.
Analyst growth estimates for the current fiscal year are 18.1%, which is lower than historical growth rates.

news.paragraph: Datadog (DDOG) saw multiple analyst price target adjustments today, with TD Cowen and Benchmark raising their targets to $260, while Macquarie maintained its $230 target and Cantor Fitzgerald reiterated its $226 target. These actions follow a recent earnings beat and a strong revenue growth trajectory, though the operating margin remains thin. The consensus analyst rating remains a strong buy, indicating positive sentiment despite the mixed price target landscape.
